state.qualification: The claim refusal decision is not registered in production: there is no implementation of ICriteriaLabelRefusalCommitter, and no claim freshness or compare-and-swap guarantees are currently qualified. The caller must verify the edition request. The event store atomically compares the expected resource position on append.
state.retry: A refused request retries after the original holder is released and a new holder acquires the label at the next generation. The caller reuses the originally recorded requested generation.

live_holder.instructions: Does the aggregate refuse only while a different exact holder is live at the state on which the refusal append is decided?

changed_intent.instructions: Does the aggregate reject retry of a recorded refusal if its edition request event ID changes?

exact_retry.instructions: In the state.retry scenario, does an exact refusal retry return success without changing the current holder?

same_position_race.instructions: If the live holder release commits at the same expected resource position before the refusal append, can the refusal append also commit at that same position under the stated store guarantee?

qualified.instructions: Does this code establish that a production provider has qualified source freshness and conditional append guarantees?

unbounded_stream.instructions: Does selecting one operation bound the length of the label owner event stream?
